icp.description: The ideal customer profile in plain words: industry, size, buyer, geography, business model, behavior or pain signals, must-haves and exclusions. Optional when an earlier step read an ICP document (its output is then the ICP) or a rubric is given.

rubric.description: Optional weighted criteria in the account-icp-qualification rubric shape (e.g. the rubric from account-lookalike-profile). When given, fit reasons are judged against these criteria; exclusions drop a company.

count.description: The most new candidates to return. list-prepare accepts at most 50 items.

fit_threshold.description: plausible keeps companies with one cited ICP criterion met and none contradicted; strong keeps only companies with two or more.

exclude.description: Companies never to return: customers, open pipeline, competitors, the seed of a lookalike search. Each {name?, domain?} or a plain string (a domain if it contains a dot, else a name).

state_mode.description: append: state_out holds only this run's new candidates, for a write step that appends rows (keeps every company ever returned). replace: state_out holds the whole seen set, newest first, capped at 100 entries, for a write step that overwrites.

max_next_queries.description: The most follow-up searches to suggest when fewer than count new candidates were found. 0 turns suggestions off.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Stamps state_out entries and report.meta. Without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions; never guessed.
